risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantitative disclosures on customer concentration, reserves, R&D spending, seasonality, and earnings, but relies substantially on standard risk-factor and forward-looking language. Key risks include fixed-cost operating leverage, customer and receivables concentration, inventory obsolescence judgments, economic sensitivity, executive dependence, and foreign-exchange exposure. Overall tone is mildly positive due to improved net income, tempered by broad and largely non-quantified downside scenarios.
